pipelines.label: Fable2 Multipass (LLM-first whole-play markup)

passes.description: P0: python-capped source digest -> DossierArtifact (facts, allowed numbers, entities, dramatizable vectors).
P1 CREATIVE 1: dossier + dealt frame cards + stance -> PitchSlate (3 pitches full mode, 1 in low-budget one-pitch mode).
P2a technical-judge: dossier + slate + stance -> PitchSelect (winner + rationale; skipped in one-pitch mode).

P2b creative: dossier + winning pitch + stance + N_MAX -> Treatment (cast shapes w/ registers, priced ending, news thread). Cast names are born here; the factual close moved to news_read (S1b read-split).
P2c technical (S1b read-split, kibitz r2 Q1): dossier + provenance -> the 1-2 sentence factual close under the anti-invention subset laws; stamped onto treatment.news_close_read by the runner.
P3 CREATIVE 2: treatment + digest + envelope -> COMPLETE play in strict markup; markup ladder + budget gate + truncation retry.
P4 technical-judge: draft + treatment -> CriticNotes (never replacement dialogue; skipped in low-budget mode).
P5 CREATIVE 3: draft + notes + treatment -> COMPLETE play rewritten with verbatim-preserve law; keep-better-draft defect judge (skipped in low-budget mode).
P6 technical-creative: winning parsed script + cast shapes + dealt voice menu -> CastingVoices (voices/portraits only; register authority stays with the treatment).
P7: pure Python assembly, no LLM -- slot is registry metadata. ParsedScript + Treatment -> ledger rows with per-constituent verbatim proof gates; incremental led.save() per scene.
P8 technical: assembled script view + treatment -> AuditFindings; evidence triage discards uncorroborated findings LOUDLY; confirmed findings = fail loud naming the defect (audit-only through S3).

notes: Visible experiment; failure NEVER routes to legacy_many_pass.
